statement: A document has at most one staged change; another stages only once it is published, abandoned or expired. A change is staged before it holds the slot, so a call still writing its candidate is never taken for a free slot, and what returns SHADOWING holds the slot and owns the candidate. A stage writes its candidate only over the candidate it read, after checking it still holds the slot, so a stage preempted while it writes never replaces the candidate of the change that took the slot.
